description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing student entities in a student attendance management system. It includes CRUD operations secured with JWT, uses FastAPI, and utilizes Pydantic models for data validation.

classes.name: StudentCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new student, including name, roll number, and optional class ID.

classes.name: StudentUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating student details; all fields optional.

classes.name: StudentOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for outputting student data, includes ID, name, roll number, and optional class ID.

methods.name: create_student(student: StudentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new student; checks for duplicate roll number.

methods.name: list_students(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of all students, supports pagination.

methods.name: get_student(student_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve details for a specific student by ID.

methods.name: update_student(student_id: int, student: StudentUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to update existing student details; checks for unique roll number if changed.

methods.name: delete_student(student_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a student record by ID.
